questions.question: A trip to the outdoor education center will help the children

analyses.content: 录音明确提到学校鼓励孩子们尝试新事物，并且在遇到困难时不要放弃，这也就是积极应对新挑战。
你可能想选B（没有成人监管），但录音中明确说明了旅行是在“熟悉的成人指导下（under the guidance of a familiar adult）”进行的。

Well, by age ten, we feel the children are ready for a trip away from home, but still in a safe environment and under the guidance of a familiar adult. At the school, we strongly believe children should be encouraged to try different things and not give up when it gets difficult. And that's what the center is all about, having a go.

questions.question: To prepare their children for the trip, parents should

analyses.content: 录音直接建议家长通过让孩子在出发前“早点睡觉（have some early nights）”来为旅行做准备，对应了保证充足的睡眠。
你可能想选A或C，但录音只是说这是孩子第一次睡帐篷，并没有让在家里试睡，同时录音也明确表示“不能保证（can't guarantee）”孩子能和好朋友分在同一个帐篷。
For some children, this will be their first time in a tent and away from home, so please prepare them. You can do this just by making sure they have some early nights before we go.

questions.question: What do parents need to put in their children's backpack?

analyses.content: 录音强调了孩子背包里真正需要放的是用于装清理物和湿衣服的塑料袋（plastic ones）。
你可能会听到饼干零食（B）或钱（C），但录音明确说零食要统一放在大厅的盒子里不能让孩子自己带，且明白地说了“不用放钱（don't worry about putting money in）”。

Please provide a packet of biscuits or maybe fruit bars, but these need to go in the box in the school hall, not with the children. Actually, what we do need in the backpacks are bags for cleaning up and for wet clothing, so plastic ones, please. A torch is a good idea, but don't worry about putting money in because there's nothing to buy.

questions.question: What are children allowed to bring on the trip?

analyses.content: 录音明确指出手机是被允许携带的（permitted），只需在晚上和教学时间关机即可。
你可能听到选项里的词就被干扰，但录音说明了中心会提供小刀，孩子不应该自己带（排除C），同时电子游戏是被严令禁止的（banned，排除A）。

Cell phones are permitted, but they must be switched off at night and also off during the teaching sessions. Also, for wood carving activities, knives will be provided by the center, so children shouldn't bring them from home. Electronic games are banned, so rather than bring one of these, children should bring quiet board games.

questions.question: How are parents selected to attend the trip?

analyses.content: 录音直接要求确认能来的家长在报名表上填名字，前十名报名的家长将被邀请参加。
你可能听到了从盒子里抽签（B），但这说的是过去报名人太多时的错误做法，而且录音也立刻排除了对露营经验的要求（排除C）。

Turning to the question of parent attendance, in the past we've had too many volunteers, so we have written names on bits of paper and pulled them out of the box. But then some parents have changed their minds. So if you're absolutely sure you can come, put your name down on the sign-up form and the first ten will be asked to come. Experience isn't required.

analyses.content: 录音在末尾给出了清晰的指令，请将装有费用的信封直接放在学校办公室（school office）的盒子里。
录音明确说了钱是由学校统一交给中心，不是家长直接付给中心（排除C），同时老师只是发带有银行账号的表格，并不是让你把钱当面交给老师（排除A）。

Payment to the center is made by school, not by parents. And your teacher will be given your child a form with the school's bank account details if you want to use them to make payments. Otherwise, please leave payment in an envelope in the box at the school office.
录音通过主大厅（main hall）定位，说明其右侧、厨房对面是烧烤区，而木雕室就紧挨着烧烤区，且俯瞰Fort's Road。
你在跟图的时候容易被大厅、厨房等多个地名绕晕，重点要抓住“right next to that”指代的是刚刚提到的烧烤区，必须锁定在烧烤区旁边。

Now the wood carving studio. So you see where the main hall is located. Well, to the right of the hall and opposite the kitchen is the new barbecue area, and it's right next to that overlooking Fort's Road.
录音明确指引你找地图的最上方、Forest Road的北边，且指明它和帐篷（tents）处在河的同一侧。
地图题最怕跟丢参照物，一听到北边千万别急着乱猜，必须要等到锁定和“帐篷（tents）”同侧这个防跑偏的关键条件。
It's crucial that children know where the emergency meeting point is. If you look to the top of the map and to north of Forest Road, that's the location. It is on the same side of river as the tents.
录音让你先找右侧河岸（right side riverbank）标着皮划艇（kayaks）的建筑，保护中心就在它正下方两座桥中间的位置。
做这道题的易错点是找错了左右河岸方向，你必须果断定位到带有“kayaks”标志的建筑，并精准锁定“两座桥之间（between the two bridges）”。

There's a lot going on at the river, for example, the conservation center. See the building marked kayaks on right side riverbank? Well, the conservation center is between the two bridges just below it.
录音清楚地说明工艺美术室在河流右侧，位于皮划艇（kayaks）再往上一点（further up）的地方。
你可能会把它跟刚才讲的保护中心弄混，一定要紧跟录音里的方位词“further up”，代表在参照物的上方，而不是在桥的下方。
If your children likes drawing and painting, the arts and crafts room is to the right of the river, a little further up from the kayaks.
